comment: Wired jigs for this project. Mode: warn (reports) -> block (refuses) once live violations are cleared. A jig is a fence with a detector. Tiers: FENCE = run + mode block; SIGN = run + mode warn; DOCTRINE = no run (honoured by agents, not mechanized). EVERY jig carrying a `run` MUST also carry a `probe`: a command exiting 0 only when that jig's machinery is actually reachable. A claim of enforcement ships its own falsifier, or it is not a claim. mw-enforcers.sh checks that and is itself registered below. mw-gate.sh is always a jig on stock/bench/finished moves. Run commands must work in both shapes: kernel/bin in the Made Well package repo, .madewell/bin once installed.

jigs.why: A row claiming FENCE while its machinery is absent is worse than no row: every reader below believes the mistake is already impossible and stops watching for it. Fossilized 2026-09-01 after three instances in one day.
